svg.title: Cell Coefficients B - Source Color
svg.desc: algebraCOEF: 3 echoes from scale 0.83 to 1.25; normal coefficient 1.45, tangent coefficient 0.8; 3 affine repetitions. Color is assigned before both spline passes, preserving source families. Seeded starting-parameter randomization varies the native source before algebra; both color orders share the same sampled settings.
